status: C35 fixtures: error-data size and error clipping measured by the native Node JSON codec (tools/json_codec_031.mjs) behind the unchanged-order receive guard (tools/guard_ref_031.py). Expected byte counts come from root's native oracles; the author computed nothing. Root executes.

initial.why: root's first loader read the native UTF-8 file with the platform default encoding (emoji 9947 vs 4447); a harness issue, not a source finding

loaderHistory.rule: every oracle file is read with an explicit UTF-8 reader; their sha256 values are recorded

perOracleRow.direct: the native codec on the busy reply carrying the row's raw data reports dataBytes == expectedJsonUtf8Bytes and dataDropped == shouldDrop
perOracleRow.integrated: S1BN, busy reply, S1HDR through the guarded HeaderNetCheck at latency 0: shouldDrop -> viewIncomplete, guard null, sleptMs 0, requests 2, decodes 0, no frame; else ok, sleptMs 250, requests 3, decodes 1
perOracleRow.previousModel: the 0.30 Python measurement (guard_ref_030.compact_bytes on the Python-parsed data) is recorded beside the native count; it is evidence of the defect, never an expectation

boundaryShape: data = {"reason":"busy","retryAfterMs":250,"pad":"<pad>"} written as raw JSON text: lone surrogates as the escape \ud800, emoji as raw UTF-8, then ASCII 'x'; 45 bytes without pad content

clip.why: slice(0, 256) cuts the surrogate pair; JSON.stringify escapes the lone half, so the re-serialized reply is valid JSON for the unchanged checker

ordering.rule: a reply that fails size, UTF-8, depth, parseStrict or the envelope id never reaches the native codec (codecCalled false for that reply)

positive.why: a result reply never calls the codec and reaches the checker byte for byte
an unchanged small error reply calls the codec once and is passed as its original text

unchanged: rate [0, 2000] and busy [250, 2000] delays, at most 3 retries, the shared 10 s RP budget, numeric id matches 2.0/2e0, byte and depth limits, the UTF-16 message cap and the declared-length order are re-run through 0.31 via the 0.30 C33 cases, the 0.29 HeaderNetCheck deadline cases and the saved 0.27 transcripts
